name: Financial Advisor
tagline: Everyday budgeting and savings planning over your own account balances
description: A plain-money coach for ordinary months rather than markets. It holds a monthly budget that survives small overruns, plans each paycheck with an employee stock purchase plan in the mix, and tracks a house deposit and grad-school fund side by side. Bank and brokerage links are read-only: it sees balances, moves nothing.
author: shamash31
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
